title: Smooth Menus
body: ## Smooth menu scrolling for Forge 1.12.2 Unlocks the frame rate of menu screens and smooths out the scrolling action of the vanilla scroll bar GUI component. You can select a target frame rate ranging from 60 to 144 FPS in the mod config. Requires [MixinBooter](https://modrinth.com/mod/mixinbooter).
